title: TAXNMY referee verdict
description: The answer of the AI referee on one proposal, for rules TP1, TP3, TP5, TK2 and TE1 and TV1. The outcome (accept, reject, alias, parked) is computed from it by code; see referee/prompt.md.

duplicate_of.description: The key of the existing product this proposal duplicates (TP3), or null.

own_product.description: TP3: a judgment with, for yes, a version of the product quoted from its versions source.

evidence.description: For yes and no: the quotes that support the answer, each copied exactly from a source text. Empty for doubt, and empty when the system prompt asks for no evidence.

version.description: A version of the product that a customer sees or chooses (a number, a build or the name of a release), copied exactly from the text of the versions source (versions.source). Null when that text shows none; TP3 is then not yes.
